products.name: Fathom
products.note: Meeting notetaker AI; auto-summaries; CRM sync; consent and privacy

profile_text.body:
Fathom is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2020 that operates an AI meeting notetaker product available for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls. The company describes its core service as capturing, transcribing, and summarizing recorded calls, and presents the individual tier as free to use. For teams, it offers AI-powered CRM synchronization, automatically pushing action items and call insights to connected tools without manual input.

The product includes a conversational search feature called Ask Fathom, which the company describes as a way to query meeting content and receive customizable AI summaries tailored to a team's workflow. It also offers AI Scorecards, presented as a real-time coaching and performance measurement tool that surfaces coaching moments and follow-up metrics for sales managers. These features are positioned around reducing time spent on manual note-taking and CRM updates.

The held facts show Fathom is registered as a public company with the SEC under CIK 0001753162 and trades under the ticker FTHM. The company also maintains a registered MCP server, ai.fathom.api/mcp, described as giving AI assistants real meeting context through Fathom so that outputs are grounded in a user's actual work. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
